fact: A Technological Center Survey for Real Estate Registration was inaugurated on 7 May 2022 to issue certified digital cadastral survey reports for the Real Estate Registration Authority, a required document for property registration under Law No. 9 of 2022.
title: Subsidiaries projects of ENSDI: Technological Center Real Estate Registration Survey
publisher: الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة (Arab Land Initiative presentation)
